messages.subject: Project Drake — company response (v3)
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver, Deepa,

Attached is our response draft (tracked over your mark-up). We've accepted the £2m founder cap, the third-anniversary survival period and the 18-month non-compete. On the basket we've countered at £225,000 (midpoint). We've also added a short use-of-proceeds reporting line at clause 5.1. Subject to those, we think we're substantially there.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Corporate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ

Oliver
